surfaces.text: An agent that entered through the installed sworn skill and followed its literal instructions to the local MCP service.
A client speaking JSON-RPC to sworn serve /mcp with no skill involved.
A person at the sworn tui board on an interactive terminal.
A shell invoking the sworn command verbs directly.
The configured agent driver Sworn dispatches role work to.

cases.text: Every surface reports the same run identity and the same lifecycle state for the same run at the same moment.
While a human-only turn is open, every surface a person can reach reports that the same one turn is waiting, with the same question.
Answering the open human-only turn through any surface admits exactly one answer and advances the run identically.
Replaying an already-admitted answer, or answering against a superseded generation, is refused on every surface without changing run state.
A transition the run does not currently offer is refused, with no partial effect.
After an interruption the run recovers to exactly one authorized continuation, and the recovered state reads identically on every surface.
